defensiveAbilities.name: Snagging Spines
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature the leviathan louse had Grabbed or Restrained successfully Escapes

Effect The leviathan louse makes a foreleg Strike against the triggering creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cling
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The leviathan louse is touching unworked stone or is on its host body

Effect The leviathan louse anchors itself in place, granting itself a +2 circumstance bonus against effects to move or trip it. It cannot take move actions. This effect lasts until the start of the leviathan louse's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Stone
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The leviathan louse is using Cling to adhere to unworked stone

Effect The leviathan louse selects one square it occupies to drain of stony sustenance. It regains 15 Healing Damage Hit Points, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. The resulting rubble becomes difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
